title: Reporting what others said
description: Powiedział, że…, zapytała, czy…, poprosił, żebym…

blocks.text: Reported speech in Polish keeps the tense of the original words: he said I will come becomes powiedział, że przyjdzie (literally he said that he will come). Statements use że, yes-or-no questions use czy, and other questions keep their question word: zapytała, gdzie mieszkam. Requests and orders use żeby with the past form of the verb: poprosił, żebym zadzwonił.

blocks.translation: He said he would come later.
She asked whether I had time.
She asked me to call tomorrow.
blocks.note: Said by a man; a woman says żebym zadzwoniła.

blocks.translation: They say it will be a cold winter.

lines.speaker: Ola
lines.text: Powiedział, że jest zadowolony, ale zapytał, czy możemy obniżyć cenę.
lines.translation: He said he was satisfied, but he asked whether we could lower the price.

lines.speaker: Szef
lines.translation: Ask him to send an email.
